title: 箱子上的纸牌  (The Luggage Tag)

segments.t: Back at the front desk, Qing, Teacher Song, and Manager Zhou lean over the blue suitcase beneath the desk lamp. Zhou finally puts his reading glasses to work. Listen first.
哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
'Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.' Small accessories that sit on the head, face, or wrist—glasses, hats, watches—use
戴
for 'wear' rather than the ordinary clothes word.
上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
'Is there a name or a phone number on it?' Notice that Teacher Song uses
或者
for 'or' here because the whole sentence is a yes-or-no question, not an 'either A or B' choice.
等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
'Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!' Short and handy,
附近
means 'the surrounding area' or 'nearby', saving you from spelling out 'near our place'.
真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
'How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.' Scheduled trips—trains, buses, flights—take
班
as their counting word, marking one timetabled run.
小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
'Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.' Mandarin places the recipient before the action on phone calls: 'to the station office strike telephone'.
我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
'I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?' Putting
正在
right before an action works like English '-ing' for something happening this very second.
宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
'Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.' For a sincere apology, Zhou says
对不起
literally 'cannot face you squarely', stronger than a casual 'excuse me'.
不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
'It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!' Shirts and tops, coats, shirts, and suitcases—and even matters of business—use the versatile counting word
件
as in 'this one coat'. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
Still no word from the train station, yet the mysterious owner knows a lane just five minutes away. Next time, Mei steps in to rescue Teacher Song's evening. See you next time.
再见！
